sections.title: WORKING WITH ROC
sections.body:
If your operation needs an enemy force, a reaction team on standby, or a rescue when it goes wrong, that is what ROC is for.

We take direction from your operation lead. Your rules apply in your op, ours apply in ours.

fields.name: OPFOR
fields.value: An opposing force that plays it straight. No stalling, no ego, nobody wrecks your event.

fields.name: QRF
fields.value: A reaction team on standby that moves the moment you call.

fields.name: SAR
fields.value: Search and rescue. Your people are down or cut off, we get them out.

fields.name: Joint operations
fields.value: Side by side on a shared objective, with our own pilots and medics.

sections.title: HOW TO BOOK
sections.body:
Open a **Work with ROC** ticket in the tickets channel. If you have just joined and are still unverified, press **Work with ROC** on the verification panel instead and it does the same thing.

Tell us:
• the date and start time, in your own timezone
• how many bodies you want
• what you want us to play
• a briefing link or a short summary

Give us 48 hours where you can. A confirmed booking gets an op card on our schedule and the people to fill it. Outside contacts hold the **{role:Guest}** role here, so you can see what you need and nothing you don't.
